subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Letter formation of 'r' (finger paint, crayon, sand tray)

show.line: Let's write r. Go down, back up, then a little bump over. r, r, rock!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says r, as in rock.
This letter says r. Say the sound!
Trace r with your finger. Down, back up, then a little bump.
Look carefully. Which one is r? It has only a little bump.

hints: r goes down, then a little bump.
Start at the top. Down, up, and over.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write r for rock.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Down, up and over, then down again. Look, I wrote r!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is n. r stops after the little bump.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Down, up, a little bump. That is r!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter r, say its sound and trace it.
